cities.title: City slugs
cities.description: The city segment from a Marketplace URL: 'nyc', 'jakarta', 'london', 'sydney'. IMPORTANT: a numeric location id does NOT work - Facebook accepts it, returns HTTP 200, and hands back listings from its own default location instead of yours. Numeric entries are rejected with a warning rather than scraped into wrong data. Leave empty to use Facebook's default location.

categories.title: Categories
categories.description: Marketplace category slugs, e.g. vehicles, propertyforsale, propertyrentals, electronics, furniture, apparel. Each is combined with every city.

searchQueries.title: Search terms
searchQueries.description: Free-text searches, run inside each city. Use this instead of (or alongside) categories when you are after a specific item.

listingUrls.title: Specific listing URLs
listingUrls.description: Marketplace item URLs or numeric item ids, to fetch the detail page of listings you already know about.

maxListingsPerQuery.title: Max listings per query
maxListingsPerQuery.description: Facebook renders about 24 listings per page and this actor replays its pagination query for the rest.

minPrice.title: Minimum price
minPrice.description: Sent to Facebook as a URL filter (verified honoured) and also applied locally. Listings with no readable price are dropped, since an unknown price cannot be shown to sit inside the range.

maxPrice.title: Maximum price
maxPrice.description: Sent to Facebook as a URL filter (verified honoured) and also applied locally.

sortBy.title: Sort
sortBy.description: Facebook's own sort. 'Newest first' is the one to use for lead generation.

radiusKm.title: Search radius (km)
radiusKm.description: How far around the city to look.

maxAgeDays.title: Listed within the last N days
maxAgeDays.description: Filtered locally against each listing's own timestamp. Facebook's daysSinceListed URL parameter is accepted and then ignored by Facebook - byte-for-byte identical results - so this actor does not rely on it.

excludeSold.title: Exclude sold listings
excludeSold.description: Drop listings Facebook marks as sold.

titleContains.title: Title contains
titleContains.description: Case-insensitive substring match against the listing title.

fetchDetails.title: Also open each listing page
fetchDetails.description: Adds the description, exact coordinates, postal code, condition, currency and vehicle specifications - none of which appear in the feed. Costs one extra request per listing.

maxDetailFetches.title: Max detail pages
maxDetailFetches.description: Caps the extra requests when detail fetching is on.

emitSummary.title: Add a run summary record
emitSummary.description: Append one RUN_SUMMARY record: listings collected, cities covered, and the min / median / max price.

exportFormats.title: Extra export files
exportFormats.description: Also write the results to the key-value store in these formats. The dataset is always produced regardless.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy
proxyConfiguration.description: Apify Proxy. RESIDENTIAL is the default and you should keep it: Facebook serves datacentre addresses a reduced page with no feed and no counts, so a run without a residential proxy usually collects nothing. The exit country also decides which country's results you get.
